text: 💡 SPOTIFY HACK: SAVE YOUR ALGORITHM! 🚨 ​Ever put on a "Deep Focus" 🧠 , "Sleep" 💤 or "Kids" 🧸 playlist for a few hours, only to find your Weekly Radar and recommendations absolutely ruined by rain sounds 🌧️ , lo-fi beats 🎧 , or nursery rhymes? 😩 ​There is a hidden button 🔘 that fixes this instantly ⚡ ! You can tell Spotify: "I'm listening to this, but DO NOT count it towards my taste profile." 🛑 ​ Here is how to do it: 🛠️ 1️⃣ Open the playlist you want to exclude (e.g. your sleep 🛌 or study 📚 playlist). 2️⃣ Tap the three dots (•••) at the top 👆 . 3️⃣ Select "Exclude from your taste profile" 🚫 . ​From that moment, you can listen to that playlist 24/7 🔄 without messing up your daily mixes and future "Wrapped" stats! 🛡️ ✨ ​ Did you know about this feature? 🤔 Drop a 🔥 if this just saved your daily recommendations! 👇
